scope: Targeted final-stage contract review only, conditional on actual accepted development evidence and new accepted final-capable code. No production sources, results, refit or freeze are certified.

reference_facts.fact: Primary generic mode is frozen from accepted v2 H30/.0025 OOF promotion; ten profile/fee choices come from accepted development own-tolerance rescreens. Sixteen final generic cases are diagnostics, not reselection.

Explicit new all-development refit replaces four 90-scenario/2700-row OOF priors for final use only. One 120-scenario/3600-row prior is shared immutably; same-path prefix updates and old development guards remain.

Generated keys give 16 cases, 960 paths, 28800 annual ledger/decision rows, 4800 horizon metric rows, 100 contrast summaries, 6000 paired rows. Five prefix horizons are 5,6,15,25,30; 7 against annual equal weights plus 3 incremental contrasts per fee/H.

Always ten personalized root rows. For eligible set E, metric rows=60*|E| and each ledger/decision count=60*sum(H for E). All eligible=9720 rows and 600 metrics; none=0; illustrative A-primary/B-doubled/D-primary=2700 and 180. Maximum fixed score rows=ledger rows, fewer after suspension.

Upstream referral has no personalized experiment or numerical outcome. Executed failures retain denominator 60 and saved outcomes. Inclusive p90<=tolerance and p10>=0 differ from strict loss>tolerance count; generated 55 at tolerance and 5 above pass p90 with exceedance fraction 5/60.

Greatest exact float drawdown, smallest scenario ID on exact tie; chronological initial/post_fee/end with strictly improving peak and drawdown updates preserves earliest locations. No metric epsilon. Own-policy severe path and baseline on that path differ from baseline own severe path.

git returns stdout decoded UTF-8 with errors=replace and outer strip; lines 233-237 hash frozen.encode(). Thus valid UTF-8 runner hash is SHA256(stripped Git text), not canonical sorted JSON and not complete blob hash. Internal spaces/order/newlines and BOM matter; outer whitespace differs only in blob hash.

Publication ordering is acyclic when freeze review is an external later attestation. Source commit pins computation; later pushed task base may add ops files. Runner gate checks control flag and digest, not scientific validity, inventory or source/refit provenance.

One inventory may use predeclared disjoint shards, not outcome-dependent retries. Genuine bug correction requires independent minimal patch review and new immutable correction task/config, retaining original freeze and exposure/receipts/partial outcomes. No bad-policy retry or arbitrary reinterpretation.

Accepted v2 design approve remains separate from historical kernel changes_required. Accepted SOL-020 is design review only. This review executes no helper and neither supersedes negative kernel evidence nor resolves pending kernel review.

implementation_requirements.requirement: Accept new final-capable loader/calibration/case/analysis/writer code on generated inputs before execution; preserve all development/synthetic guards. Bind exact input paths, bytes, schema, 121..180 x 1..30 complete keys, imported computational bytes and frozen parameters. Runner hash equality alone proves none of these.

Accept actual development primary and all ten fee-specific own-tolerance rescreens, then prepare and independently check one 120-ID/3600-row prior. Bind sorted IDs, ordered keys, input/nominal/real-gross digests and immutable shared artifact at both fees. No final fitting, pooling or fold assignment; contextual windows remain same-path last min(5,t-1), prior strength 15.

Publish exact final output schema: fold IDs/support/gate flags inapplicable (null plus explicit status), never 0 or fabricated folds. Keep all 100 descriptive contrast summaries and frozen primary; do not recompute selection or advertise three-of-four final-fold support.

Carry SOL-020 null convention into final schema: not-run upstream referral scenario_count=denominator=0; personalized statistics, exceedance count/fraction, screen flags and case path null, no 0/0. Preserve original reason/status/hash and historical proposed class separately. Executed cases use 60, including failures; incomplete/invalid execution is neither referral nor zero outcome.

Final personalized failed risk or purchasing-power screen retains proposed fixed rule and all outcomes, recommended class null, status final_validation_failed_human_review. No alternate-class/threshold search. Own H and threshold stay frozen; fee-specific different classes are counterfactual recommendations, not same-rule robustness. Preserve same-primary-mode generic comparison independently.

Freeze acceptance evidence must be external to the exact freeze it audits. Freeze can bind prerequisite acceptance commits; later audit commit binds its two distinguished hashes. No self-commit/self-hash requirement. Push accepted code/refit/config, then complete freeze and independent audit, then gate and immutable task at a later pushed base. Verify computational files against frozen source despite differing task base.

Correction record must bind original freeze digests, original task/source/receipt, attempted access and exposure, partial outputs, independently reviewed minimal patch/new source hashes, exact new immutable config/task/commands, affected versus unaffected behavior and outcome changes. Explicitly reconcile changed code against original source pin through this reviewed correction record; never falsely claim corrected bytes match old source or recreate an untouched holdout. Preserve old freeze/gate/history; prohibit policy tuning and success-only retry.

Predeclare disjoint case/path shard membership and coverage before first access, fixed commands/output roots/counts and <=1800-second attempts; enforce <=10 MiB actual files and exclusive output creation with failed staging preserved. Audits reconstruct only frozen calculations read-only with logged purpose. Severe selection uses exact float ties/strict earliest event ordering including post-fee, distinct from decision epsilon.

validity_limits: The OOF-to-all-development refit changes calibration and may change behavior; final evaluates that predeclared refitted rule, not identical OOF decisions. Development support is not a guarantee of final support.
No actual selections or profile assignments, refit artifacts, final implementation, freeze, execution receipt or performance result exist for certification in this scope.
Statistical sample screens are descriptive at n=60, not safety guarantees or significance tests. No final fold-promotion claim is applicable.

A freeze audit cannot hash its own future commit inside the same immutable freeze; use an external attestation. A corrected source must be explicitly authorized by the correction record, not disguised as the original frozen bytes.

verification_contract.check: read-only pinned Git source recomputation; HEAD-independent
verification_contract.comparison: Exact keys/counts/thresholds/nulls/hash strings/rational values; four ordinary derived float fields abs<=1e-9 or rel<=1e-10; severe float choice exact.
verification_contract.production_data: metadata only; no CSV reads or helper imports
